note.zh: 本站说明：兼容旧写法，本站会按模型自动转换成 max_completion_tokens。
note.en: On this site: kept for compatibility; this site converts it to max_completion_tokens per model.

note.zh: 本站说明：本站默认在流式结尾返回用量，传 {"include_usage": false} 可关闭。
note.en: On this site: usage is returned at the end of a stream by default; send {"include_usage": false} to turn it off.

note.zh: 本站说明：只对 OpenAI 原生及兼容模型生效，Claude / Gemini 无效。
note.en: On this site: only OpenAI-native and compatible models honor it; Claude and Gemini ignore it.

note.zh: 本站说明：只对 OpenAI 原生及兼容模型生效，Claude / Gemini 无效。

note.zh: 本站说明：只对部分 OpenAI 原生模型生效，不支持的模型会被忽略。
note.en: On this site: only some OpenAI-native models support it; it is dropped for other models.

note.zh: 本站说明：用本接口调用 Claude 时不生效，Claude 请用工具调用约束输出结构。
note.en: On this site: not applied when calling Claude through this endpoint; use tool calling to shape Claude's output.

note.zh: 本站说明：同一会话带同一个值，请求会尽量落到同一渠道，缓存命中率更高。
note.en: On this site: send the same value within a conversation so requests stay on the same channel and hit the cache more often.
